why_next: This experiment resolved the locally-testable subset of CDN concerns: PASSTHROUGH and RECOMPRESS both survive with discrimination 0.5, confirming decompression-normalization is format-invariant to proxy-added compression layers. CACHED with naive cache key is falsified but bounded to CDN cache-key semantics — a specific, fixable configuration constraint. The parent identified real CDN infrastructure as the sole blocker for C-MEAS-VALID product readiness. This experiment narrowed the real-CDN experiment by resolving the caching, re-compression, and chunked TE sub-questions locally. The next experiment should test real CDN with auth-aware cache configuration (Cache-Control: private / Vary: Authorization) to resolve the blocking blocker.

Iterative decompression survives CDN-like proxy behaviors for PASSTHROUGH and RECOMPRESS on localhost: decompressed body-only discrimination 0.5 across JSON/HTML/XML x 1KB/10KB/100KB (9 conditions) x 4 auth states x 5 reps, 0 decompression errors, decompressed hash determinism all_same=true, B-RANDOM=0.0. PASSTHROUGH matches parent direct-server hash (determinism-across-paths verified). RECOMPRESS also decompresses correctly (quality 8 layer within max_depth budget)

rejected: Single-pass client decompression does NOT survive double-brotli or triple-brotli encoding (parent established, iterative fix resolves it)

recommended_action: Design a real-CDN decompression-normalization experiment using Cloudflare Workers or Fastly Compute@Edge as a CDN proxy in front of the localhost mock server. The CDN proxy should: (1) apply real brotli/gzip compression with Accept-Encoding negotiation; (2) use auth-aware cache configuration (Cache-Control: private or Vary: Authorization) as positive control, plus default (URL, Accept-Encoding) cache key as negative control; (3) apply chunked transfer-encoding. Test all 4 auth states x JSON/HTML/XML x 1KB/10KB/100KB with iterative decompression max_depth=5. Include a non-chunked passthrough control to isolate chunked TE effect. If iterative decompression survives real CDN with auth-aware cache configuration, C-MEAS-VALID decompression-normalization reaches the threshold for VALIDATED status.
